mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_package (customer_id, name, total_amount, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{name}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO stock_package_item (stock_package_id, domestic_product_id, weight, unsuitable_confirmed_at, created_at) VALUES
(#{stockPackageId}, #{item.domesticProductId}, #{item.weight}, #{item.unsuitableConfirmedAt}, #{item.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT sp.stock_package_id, sp.customer_id, sp.name, sp.total_amount, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_package_item spi WHERE spi.stock_package_id = sp.stock_package_id) AS item_count FROM stock_package sp WHERE sp.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC, sp.stock_package_id DESC

SELECT spi.stock_package_item_id, spi.stock_package_id, spi.domestic_product_id, dp.ticker, dp.name, dp.type, dp.market, spi.weight, spi.unsuitable_confirmed_at, spi.created_at FROM stock_package_item spi JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = spi.domestic_product_id WHERE spi.stock_package_id = #{stockPackageId} ORDER BY spi.stock_package_item_id

SELECT domestic_product_id, ticker, name, type, domestic_stock_ratio, inception_date, sector_name FROM domestic_product WHERE domestic_product_id IN
#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domestic_order WHERE stock_package_id = #{stockPackageId}
